ops.note: CC barrier 25 m (10 barriers), 4 bases, 4 clamps, 2 braces, installed 21 Oct 2026 at Gate 1 (written 'GATE 1'). Recorded from Advanced's white head-office copy (page 24 of the event-week scan sent with their PO 4647522 sheet, 2 Nov 2026); the pink customer copy never reached us. Owner/site supervisor signature confirmed by Andrew Fisher as his on 2 Nov 2026, dated '21/10/25' as written (year slip); installer signed 21/10/26. Advanced's office note on their copy reads 'Deducted from braced for scrim total': their sheet bills the 2 braces as 5 m braced for scrim less 5 m clean (net 72.00) beside the CCB (25 m at 5.40 = 135.00), 207.00 in all; the bracing goes on with their approved sheet, as on 36632, 36644 and 36763. The CCB is recorded as Event: the paper does not say; Gate 1's queueing and entry CCB is Event on the programme, and unspecified CCB has been recorded as Event (36766, 36768).
